title: Sprint G7 - portfolio containers
description: SPRINT BRIEF (phase 5). Cross-repo initiatives as first-class objects: global work items of container kind whose dependencies are boreal URI references into project workspaces, with readiness derived across the boundary from rollups - a global initiative stays blocked while any referenced project item is open, exactly like local deriveReadinessStatus but fed by rollup status instead of local records. This is the cross-repo paired-work-order pattern (contract WO blocked on DB WO) promoted to portfolio level. Depends on cross-project edges (sprint G3) and the rollup contract (sprint G4). Design rule: the global container never mirrors the referenced items - it holds references and derives, so a stale rollup means visibly stale readiness, never wrong copied state.
acceptanceCriteria: All child tasks closed with passed verification evidence
